member.name: P:KineticaRT.Studio.Loader.Directories
member.summary: Array of Directories to load. Names or partial paths get appended to the BaseDirectory.
member.remarks: Ensure Collection, TranslatorFile and PersistenceFile are set before this property, as first time it is set loading is initiated automatically. Subsequently the 'LoadAvailable' channel is set, and loading occurs when the 'LoadNow' channel becomes true. To replace a directory (eg Run2 instead of Run1) without causing a complete reload, ensure that equivalent directories are in the same order as for the original load. When this property is set, the 'LoadAvailable' channel in the Collection becomes true. Note that simply changing the value of one of the strings without calling the property's 'set' method will not cause 'LoadAvailable' to be updated
